skill.name: hongguo-drama-review
skill.description: Use SocialDataX to review sampled audience comments on Hongguo short dramas identified by title, share link, or series ID.
skill.summary: Summarize audience feedback on one or more Hongguo short dramas with comment evidence and follow-up questions.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most backtick, entropy, and reconnaissance alerts match Markdown or ordinary Hongguo lookup documentation. The CLI workflow runs an unpinned npm package that can access configured credentials and does not specify how to pass user input safely. No evidence of embedded secrets, obfuscated payloads, or malicious exfiltration was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: The CLI workflow runs a mutable npm release with access to configured credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Pin an audited release, verify package integrity, and require approval before first execution. Prefer an approved, preconfigured MCP connection where available.

remediation.issue: Shell examples place user-controlled values inside double-quoted arguments.
remediation.suggestion: Pass inputs as separate arguments without shell parsing, or use structured MCP fields. Validate input types and send only the required values.

remediation.issue: The CLI can read a persistent credential file or a configured environment key.
remediation.suggestion: Use an isolated runtime with a dedicated least-privilege key. Prefer a managed secret store and verify restrictive permissions if local storage is required.

remediation.issue: Implicit invocation can begin authenticated, potentially billed queries.
remediation.suggestion: Require approval before sending inputs to SocialDataX or consuming credits unless the user has explicitly authorized that scope and budget.

remediation.issue: Billing guidance can relay a payment link from an error response.
remediation.suggestion: Always show the fixed billing URL instead of forwarding links from error responses. Let the user confirm the account and any payment independently.

content.value_statement: Viewer comments can be hard to compare across short dramas. This skill groups sampled Hongguo comments into themes and supports each theme with comment quotes and IDs.
actual_capabilities: Find a Hongguo series by title, share link, share text, or series ID.
Collect whole-series comments, deduplicate them by comment ID, and report the sample coverage.
Group comments by themes such as pacing, characters, and the ending, with short quotes and comment IDs.
Check one page of replies on one key dispute when context is needed.
Compare up to three series per batch using the same sampling limits.
Suggest up to three follow-up checks tied to specific themes and evidence.
limitations: Online queries require a SocialDataX credential or an authenticated MCP connection. Queries may consume credits.
The default sample is limited to two pages and twenty top-level comments per series. It may not represent the full audience.
The workflow does not fetch episode-level comments, download videos, or transcribe episodes.
Comments do not establish plot facts, completion rates, paid conversion, or official rankings.

use_cases.title: Identify Plot Concerns
use_cases.description: Use comments about pacing or the ending to decide which issues to verify against the series.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Feedback Brief
use_cases.description: Organize comments about characters and performances into themes for an editorial review.

use_cases.title: Compare Audience Reactions
use_cases.description: Compare discussion themes for up to three series using equal sampling limits and separate coverage notes.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize One Series
prompt_templates.prompt: Review Hongguo comments for this series: [share link]. Use the default sample and report the main themes with comment IDs.
prompt_templates.scenario: Get a first overview of one series.

prompt_templates.title: Review Character Feedback
prompt_templates.prompt: Find [series title] on Hongguo and ask me to choose if several results match. Summarize comments about [character] and include short quotes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Focus the review on one character.

prompt_templates.title: Examine a Disputed Ending
prompt_templates.prompt: Review reactions to the ending of Hongguo series [series ID]. Read one page of replies only if a key dispute needs context.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Three Series
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [series IDs] using equal page and comment limits. Show distinct comment counts and missing coverage. Suggest up to three checks tied to the evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare an evidence-based comparison for a content review.

output_examples.input: Review pacing in a Hongguo series. This example uses fictional comments.
output: Sample: 12 distinct top-level comments from two pages. No replies were included.
Pacing: 4 of 12 comments mentioned pacing. Comment A08 said, "The middle felt rushed."
Follow-up: Check how the middle episodes handle the main conflict. The sample does not establish where viewers stopped watching.

output_examples.input: Compare two Hongguo series when collection stops early. The counts and comments are illustrative.
output: Coverage: Series A had 18 distinct comments across two pages. Series B had 7 from one page before collection stopped.
Ending: Comment A05 called it satisfying. Comment B03 called it abrupt. These quotes illustrate themes, not a ranking.
Next step: Complete the planned sample for Series B before comparing how often viewers mention the ending.

best_practices: Use a share link or series ID when titles are ambiguous.
Confirm the SocialDataX connection and credit budget before collecting comments.
Report sample sizes, missing pages, and reply counts separately.
anti_patterns: Pasting an API key into a prompt, command argument, or report.
Presenting a comment sample as a platform-wide approval rate or official ranking.
Treating viewer descriptions of the plot as verified events.

faq.question: Can I start with only a drama title?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill searches Hongguo and asks you to choose when multiple series match.

faq.question: Do I need a SocialDataX API key?
faq.answer: The CLI needs a configured key. An authenticated MCP connection can use its existing credentials.

faq.question: Can the skill post comments or change my Hongguo account?
faq.answer: No. The documented Hongguo queries are read-only and do not post comments or change accounts.

faq.question: Does it read replies by default?
faq.answer: No. It can read one page of replies on one top-level comment when needed to clarify a key dispute.

faq.question: What happens if collection returns few or no comments?
faq.answer: The report describes its limited coverage. If there are no comments, it does not draw audience conclusions.

faq.question: What happens if I run out of credits?
faq.answer: The workflow stops further requests and keeps the results already collected. Check your balance in the provider dashboard before continuing.
